taxonomy_note: Initial root-cause lens; reassess final mapping.

controls.source_trace: Trace redirect destination input, parsing, canonicalization, allowlist and the flow using the redirect. Record whether it participates in a sensitive callback or merely general navigation.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned benign destination and the expected same-origin destination. Observe the actual browser/server Location resolution after transformations. For a claimed token or account chain, trace the additional sensitive flow separately rather than assuming any external redirect leaks credentials.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An external-link feature may intentionally navigate off-site. A displayed URL or rejected destination is not a redirect. Phishing potential does not by itself demonstrate account takeover.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use approved destination identifiers or robust parsing against the feature's allowed origin/path policy. Retest legitimate navigation and the exact originally accepted disallowed destination.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
